SELECT M.MEMBER_NO, M.EMAIL, M.NICKNAME, M.PHONE AS "phone", M.MEMBER_STATUS AS "memberStatus", TO_CHAR(M.CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "createDate", P.INTRO, P.GENDER, P.HEIGHT, P.MBTI, P.BIRTH_DATE AS "birthDate", S.SCH_NAME AS "schoolName", R.FULL_ADDR AS "regionName", C.CODE_NAME AS "relationship", C2.CODE_NAME AS "affection", C3.CODE_NAME AS "contact", C4.CODE_NAME AS "zodiac", C5.CODE_NAME AS "exercise", C6.CODE_NAME AS "drinking", C7.CODE_NAME AS "smoking", C8.CODE_NAME AS "social", MC.CODE_NAME AS "INTEREST_NAME", (SELECT PHOTO_URL || RENAME_NAME FROM MEMBER_PHOTOS WHERE MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO AND PHOTO_ORDER = 0) AS "profileImage", MP.PHOTO_ID, MP.PHOTO_URL, MP.RENAME_NAME, MP.ORIGIN_NAME, MP.PHOTO_ORDER
FROM "MEMBER" M LEFT JOIN "MEMBER_PROFILE" P ON M.MEMBER_NO = P.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN "MASTER_REGIONS" R ON P.REGION_ID = R.REGION_ID LEFT JOIN "SCHOOL" S ON P.SCH_NO = S.SCH_NO LEFT JOIN MEMBER_INTERESTS MI ON M.MEMBER_NO = MI.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN "MASTER_CODES" MC ON MI.INTEREST_ID = MC.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN MEMBER_PHOTOS MP ON M.MEMBER_NO = MP.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN "MASTER_CODES" C ON M.REL_INTENT_ID = C.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN "MASTER_CODES" C2 ON M.AFFECT_ID = C2.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN "MASTER_CODES" C3 ON M.COMM_ID = C3.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN "MASTER_CODES" C4 ON M.ZODIAC_ID = C4.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN "MASTER_CODES" C5 ON M.EXERCISE_ID = C5.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN "MASTER_CODES" C6 ON M.DRINK_ID = C6.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN "MASTER_CODES" C7 ON M.SMOKE_ID = C7.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN "MASTER_CODES" C8 ON M.SNS_ID = C8.CODE_ID
ORDER BY M.MEMBER_NO DESC, MP.PHOTO_ORDER ASC

SELECT R.REPORT_NO, R.REPORT_TITLE, R.REPORT_CONTENT, TO_CHAR(R.REPORT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "reportDate", R.REPORT_STATUS, R.MEMBER_NO, R.TARGET_MEMBER_NO AS "targetMemberNo",
M1.NICKNAME AS "reporterNickname", M2.NICKNAME AS "targetNickname",
C.CODE_NAME AS "codeName"
FROM "REPORT" R JOIN "MEMBER" M1 ON (R.MEMBER_NO = M1.MEMBER_NO) JOIN "MEMBER" M2 ON (R.TARGET_MEMBER_NO = M2.MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN "MASTER_CODES" C ON (R.REPORT_NO = C.CODE_ID)
ORDER BY R.REPORT_NO DESC

SELECT Q.QNA_NO, Q.QNA_TITLE, Q.QNA_CONTENT, TO_CHAR(Q.QNA_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS QNA_DATE, Q.MEMBER_NO, Q.QNA_STATUS, Q.ANSWER_CONTENT, M.NICKNAME, M.EMAIL FROM "QNA" Q JOIN "MEMBER" M ON (Q.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO) ORDER BY Q.QNA_NO DESC
